title: NCP asks Sharad Pawar to seek Congress apology or quit INDIA Bloc over ‘gungi gudiya’ remark
description: The NCP accuses the Congress of insulting Sunetra Pawar with its ‘gungi gudiya’ remark, urges Sharad Pawar to seek an apology or leave the INDIA Bloc, and draws parallels with criticism once directed at Indira Gandhi
